en.answer: You can activate the Pendulum Effect of both copies of <<12274>>, and their effects will form a Chain.
en.question:
While I control a <<12274>> in both of my Pendulum Zones, my "Performapal" monster is destroyed by battle.

Can I activate the Pendulum Effect of both <<12274>>s at this time?
en.title: Can the Pendulum Effects of two <<12274>> be activated if a "Performapal" is destroyed?

ja.answer: 質問の状況の場合、それぞれの「<<12274>>」のペンデュラム効果をチェーンして発動する事ができます。
ja.question:
自分のペンデュラムゾーンに「<<12274>>」が2枚存在しています。
